root_cause.text: The `set_new_password` function in the `dell-wmi-sysman` driver leaks plaintext passwords by dumping the entire password buffer to the kernel log via `print_hex_dump_bytes`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the line `print_hex_dump_bytes("set new password data: ", DUMP_PREFIX_NONE, buffer, buffer_size);` from `drivers/platform/x86/dell/dell-wmi-sysman/passwordattr-interface.c`, and the CVE description states that the hex dump contains plaintext password data, including current and new passwords, which leaks credentials.
